اظطلموا (form VIII)
# اِظْطَلَمُوا (iẓṭalamū) /iðˤ.tˤa.la.muː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِظْطَلَمَ (iẓṭalama)
# اِظْطَلِمُوا (iẓṭalimū) /iðˤ.tˤa.li.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِظْطَلَمَ (iẓṭalama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
